About.title: Your trusted partner for marine electronics
About.intro: EURL Technic Nautic Marine Import (TN Marine) is an authorized distributor of navigation electronics and marine paints, based in Aïn Benian, Algiers. We support shipyards and resellers as well as boat owners.
About.historyText: Based in Aïn Benian, TN Marine grew around a simple conviction: sea professionals and boat owners deserve reliable technical advice and direct access to the world's leading marine electronics brands. (Provisional content — to be completed with the company's actual history.)
About.expertiseText: Our team advises on the selection, installation and commissioning of navigation, communication and marine paint equipment, for projects ranging from leisure boats to professional vessels.
About.agreementsText: TN Marine is an authorized distributor for the brands listed below. (Details of authorizations and certifications to be completed by TN Marine.)
About.brandsSubtitle: Ten world-reference brands, each specialized in a field of marine electronics or marine paints.
About.locationText: Our premises are located in Aïn Benian, west of Algiers. Find the full address, directions and opening hours on the Contact page.

AuthGuide.title: ANF authorization for your radio equipment
AuthGuide.intro: Some marine navigation and communication equipment requires an authorization from the Agence Nationale des Fréquences (ANF) before it can be purchased and operated on board.
AuthGuide.mentionQuote: "An ANF authorization is required to purchase/operate this equipment"
AuthGuide.mentionExplanation: This notice appears on the relevant product sheets, with a link to this page.
AuthGuide.checklistHeading: Documents required for the ANF application
AuthGuide.checklistIntro: The authorization application file must be submitted to the ANF (Agence Nationale des Fréquences) and includes:

checklist.proforma: The product proforma (provided by TN Marine when requesting a proforma on the site)
checklist.role: The vessel's role d'armement (crew list/registration) or circulation card
checklist.idCard: A copy of the national ID card

AuthGuide.firstStepHeading: The proforma, the first step of your application
AuthGuide.firstStepText: Requesting a proforma on our site is the first step of your ANF application: it provides the document required to start the procedure.
AuthGuide.legalText: This authorization to operate radio equipment installed on board a vessel is issued by the ANF in accordance with executive decree No. 09-410 of December 10, 2009 (as amended and supplemented) setting the safety rules applicable to sensitive equipment.
AuthGuide.contactText: For any question, the required forms, processing times or possible fees, contact the Agence Nationale des Fréquences directly or visit its official website.
AuthGuide.provisionalNotice: List provided by TN Marine based on its field experience — to be confirmed/updated if the administrative procedure changes.
